annotation.bound_parties_text: The instrument designates the Civil Aviation Authority as the market surveillance authority for the purposes of the unmanned aircraft systems Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These Regulations prescribe the Civil Aviation Authority as the market surveillance authority for the purposes of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
annotation.dates_quote: These Regulations come into force on the day after the day on which they are made.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The Unmanned Aircraft (Market Surveillance Authority) Regulations 2025
